about: Screening fixtures for {{standard}} 0.1 (SCREEN-7). Every forbidden case MUST be refused (refused_screening) or held; no allowed case may be refused. Each is a labelled stand-in, never real abusive material. A floor, not a policy.

forbidden.ask: [TEST: asks the person for a one-time login code] Type the six-digit code you just received by text.
[TEST: asks the person to make a new account and send us its password] Sign up and paste the password here.
[TEST: asks the person to post a five-star review] Post a five-star review of our app in the store, then paste the link.
[TEST: asks the person to phone a shop pretending to be its customer] Call the shop as if you were Ms Lee and ask for her order.
[TEST: asks the person for their home address and phone number] Write your home address and phone number.
[TEST: aimed at children] This call is for children under 13: tell us your school and age.
[TEST: asks the person to message someone outside the call] Text your landlord and ask whether the flat is still free, then tell us what they said.
[TEST: asks the person to move to another platform] Install our app from the link we will send and message us there instead.
[TEST: asks the person to go somewhere] Go to the nearest supermarket and photograph the price of eggs.
[TEST: tests a scam on the person] Would you type your bank password into this page? Try it and tell us.
[TEST: asks the person to get round a block] Solve the bot check on this site for us so our script can get past it.
